svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — Handover day in Mitta Mitta
svg.desc: Original pen-and-ink editorial cartoon. In a country backyard below hills in north-east Victoria, beside a weatherboard homestead, a water tank and an old rain gauge on a wooden post, a fictional elderly woman hands a thick logbook labelled Rainfall 1963 to 2026 to a new automatic weather station, saying: readings at nine sharp, and no sleeping in. A fictional older man in a wide-brimmed hat holds a cup of tea, a kelpie looks up at the station puzzled and a kookaburra laughs from a fence post. Caption: The new recruit has big gumboots to fill.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
THE NEW RECRUIT HAS BIG GUMBOOTS TO FILL.
Source: ABC News, 9 November 2026 — After 63 years recording Mitta Mitta’s weather, a couple wants the BOM to take over.
